newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Richard Pieris shares up 12.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Richard Pieris shares up 12.8 pct.

text.p: Shares in Richard Pieris & Co Ltd rose 12.8 percent, or 10 rupees, to 88 in late Thursday morning trading, brokers said.
The rise in the shares reflected a boardroom battle among the group's major shareholders.
"There is a tussle for supremacy among two major shareholders, which is driving up prices," said a local broker.
A parcel of 12,000 shares was bid at 86 rupees, he said.
The company is a holding company of a diversified group involved in manufacturing rubber products and household goods, along with trading, transport and plantation management.
